patch_list: Lets the patched app run: stubs out PairIP's license check, which otherwise blocks re-signed builds with a license dialog. Drapes 3.9.3 only.
Enables Drapes Pro: no advertisements, image effects (blur, grayscale, dimming), auto wallpapers, and favorites sync. Requires 'Bypass PairIP license check'. Drapes 3.9.3 only.

Disables Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics collection, stops the AppMeasurement upload services, and removes the advertising ID permissions. Sign-in, favorites sync and all other features are unaffected. Drapes 3.9.3 only.
